gloss: to compete for; to pay attention to

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {取|と}り{合|あ}いませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {取|と}り{合|あ}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {取|と}り{合|あ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to compete for, to scramble for, to vie for
definitions.explanation: Multiple parties trying to obtain the same thing. Implies rivalry or contention.

definitions.gloss: to pay attention to, to take seriously, to deal with
definitions.explanation: To respond to or engage with someone or something. Most commonly used in the negative form {取|と}り{合|あ}わない (to not take seriously, to ignore).

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{合|あ}った。
examples.english: The children scrambled for the sweets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{限定|げんてい}{品|ひん}→限定品：16189_genteihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{合|あ}う⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大混雑|だいこんざつ}だった。
examples.english: The store was packed with customers vying for the limited-edition item.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧にしない、{取|と}り{合|あ}わない。
examples.english: Don't engage with them, don't pay them attention.

examples.japanese: ⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}り{合|あ}って⟦もらえなかった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: My complaint was not taken seriously.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}して→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{取|と}り{合|あ}って⟦くれない→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{訪問|ほうもん}する→訪問する：26836_houmonsuru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Since they wouldn't deal with me no matter how many times I called, I decided to visit in person.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 2 is most commonly used in the negative: {取|と}り{合|あ}わない means to refuse to engage, to not take seriously. The positive form in sense 2 is less common and appears mostly in requests or complaints.

Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), う-ending.
- Negative: {取|と}り{合|あ}わない
- Polite: {取|と}り{合|あ}います
- Te-form: {取|と}り{合|あ}って
- Past: {取|と}り{合|あ}った

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{合|あ}う: to compete for seats
- {取|と}り{合|あ}わない: to not take seriously, to ignore
- ⟦まとも→まとも：10507_matomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}り{合|あ}わない: to not engage seriously
